title: Skies of Arcadia/Accessories
text:
While weapons and armor are restricted to offence and defence respectively, Accessories can affect your characters in any number of ways - making them stronger, faster or even boosting resistance to status effects. Accessories are equipped the same way as weapons and armor, and can be bought and found in similar places. 

Like armor, accessories can fit one or more of your party members. Accessories are equipped by pressing  to open the menu, selecting the character, choosing "Equipment" from the submenu and clicking on the third equipment slot. A list of the available accessories for that character will appear, as well as a description of the piece and its effects on the selected party member.
